build_radd_reversed_addition: build a reversed addition function that swaps operands so right + left instead of left + right
build_rsub_reversed_subtraction: build a reversed subtraction function that swaps operands so right - left instead of left - right
build_rdivmod_reversed_divmod: build a reversed divmod function that computes divmod(right, left) instead of divmod(left, right)
build_rpow_reversed_power: build a reversed power function that computes right ** left instead of left ** right
test_rmod_reversed_modulo: test the reversed modulo function that raises TypeError for string operands and performs right % left otherwise
